sentences.text: Shri Rajesh Joshi G.A appearing on behalf of Advocate   ORDER This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 02.12.2015 in Session Case No.151/2014 by the 13th ASJ, Indore whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Sections 376, 366 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 10 years R.I, 10 years R.I and fine of Rs.200/-, Rs.200/- respectively with default stipulation.

2. This appeal arises out of the incident dated 24.04.2014 in which accused committed rape with prosecutrix and regarding which a Crime No.181/2014 was registered at Police Station Betma,
Indore.
3. The PUD No.2378/Warrant/2025 dated 12.06.2025 of Jail Superintendent, District Jail, Indore mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 28.01.2022 after completing the sentence.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:21386 2 CRA-263-2016 does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
